question: Which of the following dance forms is primarily associated with Eastern India states like Odisha, Jharkhand, and West Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhau**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chhau** is a traditional dance form primarily associated with the Eastern Indian states of **Odisha, Jharkhand, and West Bengal**.
 
• This dance form is known for its **vigorous martial movements** and **graceful choreography**.
 
• **Chhau** incorporates elements of **martial arts, acrobatics, and storytelling** from Indian mythology.
 
• It is performed during major festivals such as **Chaitra Parva** and **Durga Puja**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of Chhau**:

 
 
• **Seraikella Chhau** from Jharkhand
 
• **Purulia Chhau** from West Bengal
 
• **Mayurbhanj Chhau** from Odisha
 
 
 
• **Costumes and Masks**:
 
 
• Chhau dancers often wear colorful costumes and intricate masks.
 
• The masks are particularly prominent in Purulia Chhau, adding to the visual storytelling.
 
 
 
• **Musical Instruments**:
 
 
• Traditional instruments like **dhol** (drum), **shehnai** (wind instrument), and **dhamsa** (large drum) accompany the dance.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO Recognition**:
 
 
• In 2010, Chhau dance was inscribed in the **UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity**.
